programme.desc: South Korean National Security Service normally deals with North Korea, but now NSS must deal with IRIS terrorists with a nuke.

programme.title: Intruder
programme.desc: Seo-jin has lost his wife in a car accident and tries to find the culprit through hypnosis. But in hypnosis he keeps seeing his long lost sister and fails to find the culprit. One day, You-jin returns home after 25 years, but Seo-jin feels sense of otherness and discomfort. He tries to convince his family that she might not be his sister but no one listens to him.

programme.title: Beautiful Vampire
programme.desc: A beautiful 500-year-old vampire enjoys the quiet life until her new landlord and a new guy catches her eye.

programme.title: Cheese in The Trap
programme.desc: Hong Seol is an ordinary university student. She is busy working part-time jobs to pay for her tuition fee and living expenses. Yoo Jung (Park Hae-Jin) is her senior at the same university. He seems perfect. He comes from a wealthy family, he has a kind attitude to others and he is handsome, but Hong Seol does not feel comfortable with Yoo Jung. Suddenly, Yoo Jung comes and talks to her. He wants to go out on a date.

programme.title: Vanishing Time
programme.desc: Su Rin, a 6th grade student, moved due to her stepfather's job. In her new school, people label her as a weirdo and avoid her after reading her blog. However, Sung Min, from the next class, befriends her and they fall in love. One day, Su Rin, Sung , and Sung Min's friends Tae Shik and Jae Wook go to the mountains. There they find a cave under a tree which leads them to a mysterious egg. Su Rin then notices that the boys have disappeared and the police start looking for them. A few days later, Sung Min appears again but as an adult.

programme.title: More Than Family
programme.desc: College student To-il, who is a five-month pregnant ahead of her marriage, goes to her hometown to find her biological father, whom she has never seen since the age of seven. After returning to Seoul, To-il’s mom, stepdad and biological father join forces to find the groom-to-be who has been missing on the day of the meeting with bride-groom families.

programme.title: The Magician
programme.desc: The greatest magician of Joseon pulls a show to protect his love, the princess, and himself against his enemy.

programme.title: Part-time Spy
programme.desc: Government official goes undercover to a phishing group to retrieve budget, where she meets an undercover cop.

programme.title: Miracle: Letters to the President
programme.desc: In 1988, a 17-year-old genius teenage boy named ‘Jun-kyung’ lives in a village where there is no train station when the only way to get in and out is by train. Dreaming of making a way station for his sister and the villagers who have no choice but to commute along the dangerous train tracks every day, ‘Jun-kyung’ sends numerous letters to the President, but with no reply. ‘Ra-hee’, who has a crush on ‘Joon-kyung’, does everything she can to help him meet the President. Will ‘Jun-kyung’ and ‘Ra-hee’ be able to build a way station in the village and protect the villagers?

programme.title: OK! MADAM
programme.desc: Mi-Young runs a shop at a traditional market, where she makes and sells twisted bread sticks. Her husband Seok-Hwan works as a computer repairman. One day, Seok-Hwan wins a free trip to Hawaii. Mi-Young and Seok-Hwan will go on their first international trip together. When Mi-Young and Seok-Hwan get on the airplane to Hawaii, things don't go as expected. Terrorists, including Cheol-Seung, who chase after a secret agent, get on the same airplane. The passengers soon become hostages. Suddenly, Mi-Young and Seok-Hwan begin to rescue the passengers.

programme.title: The Outlaws
programme.desc: A fearless detective Seok-do decides to hunt down Jang Chen, a cold-blooded boss of Heuksapa, an uprising criminal organization that turned Seoul’s Chinatown into a blood bath. Seok-do is an old-school detective with bravado who has been protecting the peace of his city with his strong fists and bold spirit. Together with team, Seok-do plans an ultimate crime sweep to take down Jang Chen’s gangs in one night.
